title: How Crustdata built the GTM team that took it from $1M to $10M+ ARR
summary: Crustdata's data powers Contrario's agents. Contrario built Crustdata's GTM team: 5 hires, the fastest in 20 days, as ARR grew from $1M to $10M+.
body_markdown:
Contrario’s recruiters looked past sales titles and screened for two things: a technical foundation and a record of closing deals.


Two founding AEs in three weeks. Top recruiters on our network, including Tom Pugh-Jones, introduced founding account executive candidates in late October 2025. Both were hired on November 20.


A Solutions Engineer in 20 days. Jack Wang had never held the title, but as a founder he had done the job, selling a technical product himself. He also holds a master’s in computer science. Tom found him eight days after the role opened, and he was hired 12 days later.


Founding Growth. Tom also found Anmol Bhide, who ran his own growth agency while studying computer science. He joined in April 2026 to build Crustdata’s growth function.


A second wave of AEs. When Crustdata reopened AE hiring in summer 2026, Dave Turchin screened Ricky Dinh for 45 minutes, testing his technical depth and asking for a deal he had won. Ricky was hired a little over one month after the role opened.
